input: I couldn't pay the whole credit card bill this month, I'm R$ 1,200 short. Can I leave that amount in revolving credit for about three months until I get back on track?

checks.value: 30 days|next bill|following bill|next statement|next due date
checks.description: Explains that the balance can stay in revolving credit only until the next bill (about 30 days)
Says that after revolving credit the balance becomes an installment plan
Cites the cap of 100% of the original amount on interest and charges (Lei 14.690/2023)
